text: Low-voltage UPS inverter development prototype: current-limited 24 V DC laboratory input (20-58.4 V design range), 12 V and 5 V auxiliary buck regulators, 3.3 V logic, STM32 controller, 100 V MOSFET half-bridge test stage switching at 20 kHz, 5 A RMS 10 A peak, isolated gate driver (functional isolation only, single ground), INA240 phase current sensing, NTC temperature monitoring, UART and CAN, hardware overcurrent overvoltage and thermal shutdown, 4 layer 160 x 120 mm. Operating environment: indoor laboratory 0-40 C ambient. Mechanical outline 160 x 120 x 2.0 mm board, 4 x M4 holes. Quantity 5 prototypes, JLCPCB assembly. PWM hard-switched half-bridge (not resonant), output to external LC filter, functional isolation only.
